# Original experiment source

These are byte-for-byte copies of the generators, checks and Vitest configurations
used on 2026-09-23. Their `.txt` suffix keeps archival scripts out of test discovery
and prevents accidental execution against the original output directory. The
[manifest](manifest.json) records their original names and SHA-256 hashes.

They retain historical workstation paths. Use the portable diagnostics described
in [the investigation README](../README.md) to recheck the frozen inputs. If you
adapt a generator, use the pinned [requirements](../../requirements.txt), the
existing public test identity, and a fresh output directory. Never replace a
frozen fixture or transfer an Acrobat observation to newly generated bytes.

The generators use the parent corpus's `generate.py`, `generate_v2.py`,
`generate_v3.py` and `verify_v3.py`. They deliberately bypass production mutation
permission gates for negative probes. They are not a production implementation
of annotation naming or identity transitions.
